content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

The sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to empower digital creators by providing them with a decentralized and autonomous way to sell their products online. This infrastructure is built on the principles of ownership and control, allowing creators to manage their businesses without relying on third-party platforms. By leveraging blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies, creators can now accept payments from a global audience, expanding their reach and potential earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of this infrastructure combines various components, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Additionally, it utilizes NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, enabling seamless transactions. This robust architecture ensures that digital creators can focus on producing high-quality content while leaving the technical aspects to the infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or restricted, such as Kenya. These creators can now sell their music, ebooks, courses, and other digital products without being limited by geographical constraints. By providing an alternative payment solution, this infrastructure bridges the gap between creators and their global audience, fostering a more inclusive and equitable digital economy.
Empower your digital business with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this infrastructure work in harmony to provide a seamless experience for digital creators. For instance, Cloudflare Workers enables automated delivery of digital products, while NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions. Supabase, on the other hand, provides a robust database for storing orders and customer information. By integrating these components, creators can build a reliable and efficient commerce system that meets their specific needs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, digital creators can start by selecting the components that best suit their needs. They can then follow a step-by-step guide to set up their commerce system, configure payment processing, and integrate their digital products. With the right tools and knowledge, creators can launch their online stores and start accepting cryptocurrency payments in a matter of hours, marking the beginning of their journey towards financial independence and sovereignty.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies with ease.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
